subject.title: msteams: support Copilot-only streaming without enabling Teams DM streaming

question: Should msteams add a permanent Copilot-specific streaming config surface, and what detector/key shape should be accepted?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the durable API shape and the reliable Copilot activity signal are product/owner decisions that source inspection cannot safely choose.

options.title: Approve after live metadata proof
options.body: Add a plugin-owned Copilot detector plus either `streamingBySurface.copilot` or `copilotStreaming`, with global `channels.msteams.streaming` as the default fallback and focused tests/docs.

options.title: Keep global-only streaming
options.body: Decline new config surface for now and document that operators must choose one Teams-wide streaming mode until Microsoft metadata is proven stable.

options.title: Defer into a broader Teams surface model
options.body: Wait for a more general msteams surface taxonomy covering Teams, Copilot, DMs, groups, and channels before adding any targeted streaming key.

recommendation.title: Approve after live metadata proof
recommendation.body: Add a plugin-owned Copilot detector plus either `streamingBySurface.copilot` or `copilotStreaming`, with global `channels.msteams.streaming` as the default fallback and focused tests/docs.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current Teams SDK streaming boundary and are the strongest history-backed owner for validating SDK/activity metadata assumptions.
